Class SelectionQuery

java.lang.Object
java.awt.geom.RectangularShape
java.awt.geom.Rectangle2D
java.awt.Rectangle
com.j3d.engine.interact.selection.SelectionQuery
All Implemented Interfaces:
Shape, Serializable, Cloneable
public class SelectionQuery extends Rectangle
A SelectionQuery represents a selection made by the user. It is represented as a rectangle defined by two ScreenPoints (the corners). It can be used to check whether certain GObjects are within the selection.
Author:
Lehlogonolo Poole

    • has

      public boolean has(GObject obj, boolean soft)
      Whether the Selection has the given GObject.
      Parameters:
      obj - The GObject to check.
      soft - If false, we strictly check whether the GObject is fully contained within the selection. Otherwise, we check whether the selection does so much as intersect with the GObject.

      Whether the Selection has the triangle.
      Parameters:
      triangle - The triangle to check.
